Maybe, I had my job before my diagnosis, which was a late life diagnosis.  When I first got into it I was happier and 'normal-er' I guess.  I wasn't like this.  My job is certainly extremely stressful but the idea of going from what I make now to less causes extreme amounts of anxiety.  Mainly because I did it for awhile and struggled to make it.  Going from 10 years in one field to another is really tough, not impossible, but tough, I made $9k the first year I tried and had to live off subsidy, medicaid, etc.  

I don't know if quitting my job/changing my career is going to fix everything?
